allow: Creating issue and PR comments and review-thread replies (gh issue comment, gh pr comment, a POST to pulls/<n>/comments/<id>/replies), editing one through dk-comment-edit, and adding or removing labels on issues and PRs (gh issue edit or gh pr edit with --add-label or --remove-label), on a repo owned by kaminski-dev that is not a fork, are allowed, one at a time or in a loop. This does not cover another owner's repo, a fork's upstream included.
hard_deny: Never run docker or podman prune, and never remove containers, volumes or images this session did not create.
Never push to main or master; changes reach main only through a merged PR.
Never print or copy the contents of credential files such as ~/.sentryclirc, ~/.aws/credentials or ~/.netrc.
